text:
Jordan (customer): Hi, I'm trying to apply promo code `START-50-ACME` to our org (Acme Labs) but the dashboard says it's invalid/expired. We were promised a trial when we signed up.
Alex (Support): Sorry about that — can you paste the exact error you see or a screenshot? Also which email/account you used to sign up?
Jordan (customer): Error shown: `Promo code rejected: invalid_or_expired`. I signed up with jordan@acmelabs.com (SSO via Okta). Screenshot: https://img.redwood.invalid/screengrab-abc123 (attached).
Alex (Support): Thanks — quick checklist: 1) promo codes sometimes scoped to individual emails vs org-level vouchers, 2) SSO/already-used trial can block reissue. I'm going to run a lookup. Hold on.
promo-bot: Running promo lookup for `START-50-ACME` against account `acme-org-0042`...
promo-bot: Lookup result: code=START-50-ACME status=active scope=user_only expires=2025-12-31 redeemed_by=jane.doe@partnerco.com
Alex (Support): Interesting — the code is active but scoped to a specific user (user_only) and already redeemed by a different email. That would explain the invalid/expired message for org-level apply.
Jordan (customer): We were told by sales it would apply to the org, not a user. Can you confirm?
Beth (Billing): Jumping in — if sales promised org-level credit we can reissue or apply a manual credit to the billing account. Need the org billing id and approval from the sales contact. Who's the AE?
Jordan (customer): AE is Lina from Sales. Our billing id is `acct-acme-0042`. Lina confirmed in email thread: "org credit approved" (I can forward).
Alex (Support): Ok please forward Lina's confirmation to support@redwood.com and I'll attach it to the ticket. Meanwhile, if you'd like immediate relief we can provision a manual $50 promo credit to the billing account while we sort the voucher scope. Do you want that?
Jordan (customer): Yes please — that would be great.
Beth (Billing): I can apply a one-time credit. I just need account owner email + last 4 of billing CC or a billing contact confirmation (email from Lina is fine). Once I have that I'll post the transaction ID here.
Jordan (customer): Forwarded Lina's email to support (subject: "Acme org credit approved"). Billing contact is finance@acmelabs.com. Last4: 4242.
Beth (Billing): Got the email, validating...
Olivia (Ops): Quick note — we recently had a bug where user-scoped promos created by partner sales weren't flagged as org-wide in the promo UI. I've opened an internal issue: #INF-4921. If reissue needed, I can coordinate so it doesn't happen again.
Beth (Billing): Manual credit applied: $50 credit posted to acct-acme-0042. Transaction ID: TXN-2025-87654. Visible in Billing > Credits now. :white_check_mark:
Jordan (customer): I see it, thanks so much! The dashboard shows $50 credit applied.
Alex (Support): Great — I'm updating the ticket and am going to reissue a proper org-scoped promo code so you have an official voucher for teammates. ETA ~ 24h.
Beth (Billing): For audit — leaving a note that original code `START-50-ACME` remains user-scoped and flagged as partner-only, redeemed_by=jane.doe@partnerco.com. Reissued code will be `ACME-ORG-50-REISSUE`.
Jordan (customer): Thanks all. Closing on my side after I test with a teammate.
Alex (Support): Follow-up: reissued code posted in the ticket and emailed to jordan@acmelabs.com. Please confirm once you apply it and I'll close the thread. :sparkles:
Jordan (customer): Reissue worked for me and my teammate, code applied successfully. All good. :thumbsup:
Alex (Support): Marking resolved. If anything else comes up ping us in #support.
